battering ram noun

classical

Cic. Off. 1.35; Caes. BG 7.23; Liv. 21.12 (Lewis & Short)
Andresian p. 48

ariēs, arietis m.

noun, third declension

a battering ram

First the ram, the male sheep; then the beam for battering down walls (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • quamvīs mūrum ariēs percusserit

    even though the ram has struck the wallCic. Off. 1.35 (Lewis & Short)

See also catapult.
